lobby.help.answerSec: One clock for all the questions, not one each. Players move through them at their own pace and can skip and come back. It ends early the moment everyone has handed in.
lobby.help.guessSec: How long the room gets to pick who wrote the answer on screen. One tap and it is final, so short is tense and long is forgiving.
lobby.help.questions: How many questions everyone answers before any guessing starts. More questions means a deeper pool to draw from — and a longer answering phase.
lobby.help.revealSec: How long the author and the points stay up before the next question. Short keeps the pace, long lets the room react.
lobby.help.rounds: How many answers get put to the room, one per round. Not every answer gets used: 5 players answering 5 questions makes 25 answers, and 10 rounds only asks about 10 of them.
lobby.help.standingsEvery: How often the game stops to show the scores and who has climbed or dropped. Set it to Off to go straight from one question to the next.
